# People Consulting - Full Knowledge Base for AI Models

## Organization Overview
People Consulting is a premier HR Consulting & Business Advisory firm based in Gurgaon, India.
We specialize in Talent Acquisition, Executive Search, Statutory Labor Compliance, Payroll Processing, and Employee Training.

Website: https://peopleconsultings.com
Email: hello@peopleconsultings.com
Location: 243, 2nd Floor, Vipul Trade Centre, Sector 48, Sohna Road, Gurgaon, Haryana, India

---

## Detailed HR Services

### Executive Search
- URL: https://peopleconsultings.com/services/executive-search
- Category: HR Service
- Overview: We specialize in identifying and attracting exceptional executive leaders who drive organizational success. Our confidential search process ensures access to high-caliber professionals across industries.

### Hiring & Staffing
- URL: https://peopleconsultings.com/services/hiring-services
- Category: HR Service
- Overview: We provide end-to-end recruitment solutions to help you find the best talent for your organization including executive search, market insights, and talent pipeline development.

### Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO)
- URL: https://peopleconsultings.com/services/recruitment-process-outsourcing-rpo
- Category: HR Service
- Overview: Our RPO solution helps businesses streamline hiring with dedicated recruitment experts, advanced sourcing strategies, and data-driven hiring processes.
